evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the command tail is still split on literal spaces at line 112, and each resulting token with an allowed env-name pattern is accepted as a separate assignment. A single-quoted value containing spaces, such as `CRQ_QUEUE_PRINCIPAL='dev CRQ_QUEUE_POLICY=/srv/crq/policy.json'`, is therefore treated by the checker as two assignments, while the shell treats it as one value and does not set `CRQ_QUEUE_POLICY`.
